cognitive-complexity-rule.desc: Verifies that every function has a SonarQube cognitive complexity score below a maximum.
cognitive-complexity-rule.config: - max: maximum cognitive complexity allowed per function (default 8) - ignore: list of functions to skip. A file path followed by `::` and the function or `Type::method` (e.g. `src/main.rs::run`, `src/main.rs::Config::new`)
